release_notes: Analytics Autopilot now reads YouTube watch-time, average-view-percentage, subscriber and engagement metrics for published full quizzes after YouTube is reconnected with analytics permission.
Full quizzes are automatically classified as Learning, Winner, Healthy, Packaging rescue or Weak topic using view velocity and watch quality against the channel baseline.
Generate + Autopilot now steers future batch categories toward proven performers while reserving rotation and experiment slots so the channel keeps learning.
Packaging-rescue videos automatically get a fresh local A/B title and thumbnail package prepared without silently changing a live YouTube video.
Analytics refresh runs automatically after startup and alongside YouTube Manager refreshes; existing public view history is used as a fallback until richer analytics is available.
Growth Autopilot continues to organise category playlists, start Question 1 at zero seconds and reserve the final 15 seconds for YouTube end-screen elements.
